notes:
{演算|えんざん} refers to mathematical or logical operations, especially in computing and mathematics contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {演算|えんざん}する: to compute, to perform an operation
- ⟦{四則|しそく}→四則：28865_shisoku⟧{演算|えんざん}: four arithmetic operations (+, -, ×, ÷)
- ⟦{論理|ろんり}→論理：06026_ronri⟧{演算|えんざん}: logical operation (AND, OR, NOT)
- ⟦{演算子|えんざんし}→演算子：23586_enzanshi⟧: operator (in programming/math)
- ⟦{浮動小数点|ふどうしょうすうてん}→浮動小数点：30119_fudoushousuuten⟧{演算|えんざん}: floating-point operation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧: calculation (broader, everyday word for math)
- {演算|えんざん}: operation (more technical, emphasizes the process performed by a machine or formal system)

REGISTER:
Technical/formal. Used in mathematics, computer science, and engineering. In everyday language, ⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧ is the natural choice.
